responsibility: Provides the generic compiler query runtime by defining the shared query context and data exposed to the rest of the compiler, the per-query configuration interface that describes how each query executes and participates in incremental compilation, the cache abstractions and concrete cache layouts used to store results and dep-node indices, the active-job and wait/cycle management needed for parallel execution and diagnostics, and the plumbing that ties these pieces together into query lookup, execution, dependency tracking, disk loading, forcing, and recovery behavior.
